body:
From the ashes of division: Horn, Phelan and Andrews chart a new course for Colorado GOP
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-nbZw/s8q1feee575)
---
**March 30, 2025** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
This weekend, the Colorado Republican Party [started a new chapter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-nbZw/s9rf068ce2d). At Saturday’s reorganization meeting, delegates elected a new leadership team: Brita Horn as Chair, D. Lee Phelan Sr. as Vice Chair, and Russ Andrews as Secretary—a slate that spoke unified in message and mission: _stop the infighting, and start winning again._

In a second-round vote, Horn [secured the chair position](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-nbZw/s7vccb468aa) with 232 votes to Lori Saine’s 203, after four other candidates withdrew and put their support behind her. The newly elected leaders wasted no time laying out a roadmap for party revival.

Horn, a former fire chief, invoked her roots in crisis response: “If we’re all standing around blaming each other while the house is burning down, we’re not putting the fire out.” She emphasized action over posturing, calling for a return to teamwork, training, and real grassroots support.

Vice Chair Phelan brought a focus on structure. Having rebuilt a struggling county party, he stressed the need for better coordination, reliable data, and support from the ground up—starting with precinct leaders.

Secretary Russ Andrews outlined a bold plan for outreach and growth. From faith communities to gun owners to Latino voters, Andrews made the case for active engagement, coalition-building, and consistent communication. “If you agree with 80% of my values,” he said, “you’re my friend and ally—not my 20% enemy.”

The tone was hopeful after the past two years of mudslinging, lawsuits, and power struggles. Horn and her team seem committed to moving in a new direction. The fight ahead isn’t among Republicans, they reminded the room—it’s with the entrenched political class steering Colorado in the wrong direction.

That message was echoed powerfully at [Friday night’s Centennial Gala](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-nbZw/sdg7bb39e78), where hundreds gathered to hear Steve Bannon deliver a fiery call to action. While Bannon’s speech made national headlines—warning of “elites who don’t want you in their party”—the next day, Colorado Republicans said loudly they’re ready to lead a new era with action, and a focus on winning races.

Now the hard work begins.
In liberty and truth, Heidi

MJS: Early voting surpasses 500,000 in Wisconsin's election featuring pivotal Supreme Court race
Team: On Tuesday Wisconsin voters will decide between progressive Dane County Circuit Court Judge Susan Crawford and conservative former Attorney General Brad Schimel in a race that will determine the ideological balance of the court.
Why is this election important? Wisconsin's Supreme Court elections are nonpartisan, but the ideological balance of the court has widespread ramifications for voting rights, civil rights, and a slew of other state policy implications. [1]Justice Democrats

Hey Peter, it's
Summer!

Listen—last week, I introduced the Abolish Super PACs Act because enough
is ENOUGH. Billionaires and special interests have been treating our
democracy like it's their personal playground since the Supreme Court
opened the floodgates back in 2010. They've been spending millions (even
billions!) like it's pocket change, drowning out the voices of everyday
folks. It's outrageous, and it's gotta stop.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250330-sl?refcode=em20250330-36546&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36546_1203867_3HABUe&akid=36546%2E1203867%2E3HABUe ]Before I get fired up (well, more fired up ), let me ask you straight
up: Can you click here and chip in $15, $25, or even $50 today to my
campaign and Justice Democrats? Every single dollar matters because unlike
these billionaires, we can't just casually drop a million like it's
nothing.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250330-sl?refcode=em20250330-36546&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36546_1203867_3HABUe&akid=36546%2E1203867%2E3HABUe ]Forbes Breaking News: Rep. Summer Lee (D-PA) and Rep. Ro Khanna (D-CA)
unveil bill to ban super PACs in federal elections.

Super PACs weren't even a thing before 2010—then Citizens United and
SpeechNow.org v. FEC changed the game. The Supreme Court basically handed
our democracy over to the ultra-rich and corporations. Now, we've got a
system that's rigged against working-class folks who dare to challenge the
status quo.

I know y’all feel it—this broken system means we have to hustle for every
dollar, every week, every month—even when our next primary is a year away.
And while we're over here grinding to raise $1,000, billionaires toss
around millions like it's nothing. That's exactly why we can't take our
foot off the gas, even for a second.

The Abolish Super PACs Act caps contributions at $5,000—effectively
putting an end to these shadowy groups altogether. This bill is about
taking power back from the wealthy few and handing it back to the
people—where it belongs.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250330-sl?refcode=em20250330-36546&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36546_1203867_3HABUe&akid=36546%2E1203867%2E3HABUe ]We can't keep fighting the good fight without your support. So, I’m
asking again because this fight is REAL and URGENT: Can you help fuel this
movement today with a split donation of $10, $20, or whatever you can?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250330-sl?refcode=em20250330-36546&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36546_1203867_3HABUe&akid=36546%2E1203867%2E3HABUe ]Contribute $5

This fight isn't just about politics—it's about reclaiming our voices, our
communities, and our future. Thank you for standing with me! Let's keep
pushing, keep fighting, and keep giving them hell!

With much love and fire,

Summer Lee

Team,
When I stepped into my classroom as a public school teacher, I never imagined that one day I would be here, on the brink of flipping a Trump-held seat in Congress.
But this movement, built by people like you, has already defied expectations at every turn. The political insiders and pundits said this race was unwinnable. They dismissed our chances, counted us out, and assumed we would never get this close. Yet, here we are, just one day away from proving them all wrong.
This campaign has never been about me. It has always been about the students I taught, the working families fighting for a better future, and the people who have been left behind by career politicians who care more about power than about the people they represent.

clean_body: I never imagined that one day I would be here, on the brink of flipping a Trump-held seat in Congress. | | | | | == Team, When I stepped into my classroom as a public school teacher, I never imagined that one day I would be here, on the brink of flipping a Trump-held seat in Congress. But this movement, built by people like you, has already defied expectations at every turn. The political insiders and pundits said this race was unwinnable. They dismissed our chances, counted us out, and assumed we would never get this close. Yet, here we are, just one day away from proving them all wrong. This campaign has never been about me. It has always been about the students I taught, the working families fighting for a better future, and the people who have been left behind by career politicians who care more about power than about the people they represent. | | | | | == | | | | == | | | | | == | | | | We are so, so close. ## Trump Pressures Iran Over Nukes
President Trump warned Sunday that [Iran faces bombing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1q8zAYBeCrkTcZ6ZX_MmhI-PCWj0JpMxr9vIrVypKRlZjcfXH3Tmc4cDg8t-t0VT74eP-vFpTFpQkYtJQJKvhklQ-vqamsdIiAokLJ-0Y0vBWCVbPsW-MMmBMAGK0FWHZyzOkeeWPsMGDl5bHGhOCcMcbbuoOOg9FNpzsY9OBIw9D6knL9lXwsM7rwSk_MtUlLFeRcyroRcSYwEhj3fa-XLR4dgREjfWwExoj7EXvKwRIYS34sKy1zRlUwblSnRft4p95Rn1WkNuFGYyp0Ud9I48MEVJlaVIHAqDI9n_nl9vn2QcSYjLdE_LscOrhv75jXKku77j4Ev3U9adh9UT78ni1_4T0l_AQAAP__2dxySg) "the likes of which they have never seen" if it refuses a new nuclear deal. Trump’s comments came in an NBC interview that aired Sunday, taped hours before Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian [rejected direct negotiations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOgzAQRL_GdEb2rnFI4eIaulx7JQKzhI0MjswmKH9_4vqrZqSR5knv59bfBk683b-HlYLMuQcDjTao0fbTwOnTu2oKMxEQVhTsxaGzDaKpljBdfUOAVz9bE9FA6yGib2MEN17d6CoO55tBtNYYY5vag7cQR-dHD-3YzsoZmlhyqR-ZN1loTp_8plLHvFYpLCLPXeGXgk5BdxxHHcd9o2M_dwXdWRV0XIZNCy1nFHpQFJr0RvcsPAjnbdevXUt5rU-dSISKgq4qYXoenBLv_qKcua8Dpz-s_KfhHeA3AAD__9SPX-0) with the White House, while suggesting that indirect talks could continue. It was Iran’s first official response to a letter that Trump sent earlier this month, in which he urged that a deal be reached over Iran’s nuclear program. Trump added that Iran could face [secondary tariffs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2unDAUBOCnMd1B_gN2Cxd7FdHdTZFiS2TjAzgxNrLNWvv2EelTTTHSSPO9vqdv7bwL61PvqMoSJ055B1SAYJPVzn8m2Vi1IHIUDSo2SCFZJwRtNiXv2N8sdoyKebjTOwo6MGrsPBiGs-SNU9caFYIxSinr2p73jM9G9qbnN3NbiKRoXYmp_R1dKBsu_hPfmNo57o1XWylHJuJB-Ej4WGtt9xyujvARA5yZ8DFgvSKWDRPhY0nnfkDZEuqCIUOJYOJuwCUd4Awec4ay4QcwWAjn7FEnqKiPGDIcKa5J76CDBYOrC1C0_5MhBghYwaL2hI86wePBvl4_nycRY5ydJeLH12WINf_CdDRJ2aM6713uByLpumvn_10q_yN-K_43AAD__956gA8) if no deal is reached and said that U.S. and Iranian officials are “talking.”
## U.S. Businesses Back Reciprocal Tariffs
As President Trump prepares to unveil reciprocal tariffs on April 2, which he dubbed "Liberation Day," [U.S. businesses are pressing the White House](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO3SAUAL8Gd1hwwI8tKNK427QpLWwO5kQ8LOCudf8-2vTbj0aj-fO5f1qKlK_fNqHpvuwgYOJCcSV3Zym-dz044xEB1YBGLlppOSklhmDk_OGmBWDVCj60XhEnOy-rdxImJbUYyHzbhFJSCiHkNM4wSzgPPR8zrMfqmRboqJc6_i2Ue0Af3-UL63iWNEQTer8bU78YbAy253nGHrBTwvYNMNiOV6OMrfFUMr4ZbHiWXBKdjcFma6czIoOthUrp5jY7fsQXHlgrYeMl824rec8DdR6pdR5sduh4L7zXV7p5SPFK_mpxqMbdD8VIbV6YFleyFP9n9p-2fRn4FwAA__-P9XGK) to address trade imbalances with the UK, EU, Canada, and others. JM Smucker sent a letter to the White House earlier this month citing the [EU’s 24%-plus tariff on American jams](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71urDAQxfGnsbtF4xnDunFxG7q9bUrkj_GuI4M3YIHI00ekT3ekI_2k_8djerhc8vL872a2LdUJAfsb0I3UFF0u56RltIkZmSRbddekVU8E8mXxHhiIExtjXO-NJ0cuOed8Ip1iL7O9NCBSCgBU3w04KAxeD35A400SGjjmVtfus-alvTiVs-68dqHOsthXa-9N0D-Bo8DxOI7O-3B9AseFj03g6NaWQ-FrBtDfcMb9q2CVq43vI5eSt-EuNDxnl8uv2v6q3C3-BAAA__--a1Qc)—compared to a U.S. maximum of 4.5%—and saying it has restricted their exports to just $300,000 annually. The Oregon Trawl Commission noted UK duties of 12% to 18% on cold-water shrimp, and the North American Blueberry Council pointed to levies like 20% on frozen sweetened blueberries. Though Trump suggested last week that [his tariffs might be "very lenient"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vwyAUAH8N3rAej4-QgaGLt3TtaD1jiKmwsTCN5X9fpXvnk-6k-3qMD0o5bc9PWoNrsYwIqDlILsU4U8rXqLrZxRAwyC44cVNSCS0ldIu7B49S3jUACW_hZixFo3Qkba3QwnfJvW0gpRAAIHRv0Aj0kzKTQTvZyBSEObVS---StraEmK_yCrX3Ze2yW1rbDyY_GA4Mh_M8-4uWUt6U4bCF82A4tPqz7vyg6-A1-LTX4inzRjXFyPdMG0cUCFYJ7Je25q66eT9TzukwN6bguVLKf8H234CXw98AAAD__xoAXAQ) and lower than expected, his final approach remains uncertain.
## TV Star Richard Chamberlain Dies at 90
Television and movie star [Richard Chamberlain died](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO5CAQBb8GZ1h0g8EXEFzibC690Gqb9sAdNiPMjjV_v9rZeJMXPZVK9fc23yjldNz_0M6-bWVGhYNUWmqYA6X8mk0X_MaMrDv24Iw2MGituuiB9Qh2daw0DUxA4AjQgHODBrv86pL_oimtAZRSMPQWLeC6GLtYHJdxE0ZxSK3U_l9JR4u85Vd5cu3XsnfZx9Yep9C_BU4Cp-u6-lhyfl2lhMqPUtv3U-DUnu-RB1-nwKmmNVINco20L1wzpUMGpiBDlf9TDlRZnrHcPw55NqoSUFtwg4NR4NRVHx5Xyjmd1gmj7jul_DZqPxV6evwMAAD__04aZ7c) Saturday in Hawaii, just two days shy of his 91st birthday. Chamberlain was best known for his role in the TV miniseries _Shogun_ and _The Thorn Birds_ after rising to fame in the title role of [_Dr. Kildare_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uwyAURp8Gb1j82YkHhi7e0rWjdYHrcCsMEdBYefsq3bt90icdHZ2v23YDSpTvn3Cg7XvZlFATF5pruQWg9NrMEOyOqFAPaOXFaCMnrcUQLfrFmR00-EVP6NFcQ_DLdDG4AxotBrJvmtBaSiGEnMZZzVJ5Z2Y3q6u77swIDNRLHb8L5R5xT6_yxDr6cgzJxt4fjekPplam1vM8R-9axrO9f6bW92RqreQj1MB9hMNhTUCZtw6Vt1juP5lDDrxH5D2WmrmjGhoPhI0vgql1qDY8TkqJ2nxhRtwPoPQn0P8L8rTqNwAA___z32Qm). After being raised in Beverly Hills and serving in the U.S. Army in Korea, Chamberlain became a 1960s heartthrob, embarking on a decades-long career that spanned television, film, theater, and music. Chamberlain died after complications from a [stroke](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zz1vwyAQxvFPA1us4w6wF4Yu3tK1o8XLkVBhEznIbr59le7dHumRftL_67pcfallu336lV3PbUFAcwG6kFqSL_W1aJlcZkYmyU6NmrQyRCDvLhpDI0c_UYg6TcZz8oA8jmByztHK4t4aECkFAMoMFq3CGLQNFqcwZaGBU-ltH75b2fqdc321g_chtlVWd-_98RT0IXAWOJ_nOYQQ35_AeePzKXD2ey-x8nvGH8btgDUd2OTu0uMstZanHYWG2-pL_VP7f5WHw98AAAD__4qiU_A), according to his publicist.

| | | | friend, If you and I haven't met yet, my name is **Josh Weil**. I'm a single father, Democrat, and public school teacher running in the Special Election for Florida's 6th Congressional District -**_the bellwether first election of 2025._** As we begin to hit our stride after a whirlwind first few weeks of this campaign, I haven’t yet had the chance to sit down and write out the story of who I am & why I’m running so let me tell you about why you should put your belief into this scrappy campaign that _stands to topple the GOPs razor thin 1-vote majority._ My career has been **_defined_** by work with at-risk or post risk populations in public schools. I worked for three years in juvenile detention under the FL Department of Juvenile Justice, then for two years at University Behavioral Center, a residential mental health hospital for teens. In these programs, kids were typically _5 years behind grade level_ and the programs were _extremely_ underfunded and under-resourced. As a result I had to wear a bunch of different hats - teacher, therapist, parent, and more. **It’s a helluva a job (literally),** and it’s not for everybody, but I am proud to have made a tangible impact with these students and this experience was _foundational_ in making me the teacher that I am today. I now work in Florida’s Osceola County public schools where I am on the leadership team of Kissimmee Middle School - a title one school (schools which have a high population of low income families and in turn receive lots of extra supplemental funding, all students receive supplemental funding). On the leadership team of Kissimmee: I’m an instructional coach for teachers, the Dean of Students where I handle behavior issues with students and families, and the MTSS coordinator - a role required under education law where I monitor/track student data across the school and then coordinate interventions and individualized education plans (IEPs) for students who are underperforming. In my first year where I oversaw Math, scores went down in every category at my school **_except_ math** which went up one point. In my 2nd year, I oversaw all of STEM where we made major gains in both categories and became the __**_highest gaining_** __ **_school_** __ in the whole county/district for that category. I have devoted my life’s work to **solving challenges that seem insurmountable to most** , to uplifting students and classrooms that society and our GOP state legislature have written off. So when I read that a special election would be held in my community for a vacant House seat following a Trump cabinet appointment, I saw an opportunity to tackle a challenge that I am uniquely qualified to take on and conquer. Before our launch, we were warned by Doubting Thomases that the Democratic base was burnt out, defeated, and apathetic in the aftermath of Kamala Harris’s defeat. We were told that we would be hard pressed to find people who would donate and or volunteer on this race. _They told us to give up._ My belief then and ever more so now is that when the chips are down and we’re backed into a corner is when we fight the hardest—and**now I am vindicated _every day_ as Democrats from across the US pour in to _fight with us_**. [**_Together we can rob the GOP of their 1-vote majority and restore hope to a movement reeling from our 2024 defeat - can you make a donation today to help us rapidly scale this campaign in time for our April 1st election?_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wysg0-vzsld9-kyd76rh1/)

## Historic Rainfall, Flooding Drench South Texas
Gov. Greg Abbott issued a disaster declaration for four South Texas counties on Saturday after [torrential rain led to widespread flooding](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOgzAQBNCvMR1ovTbEFC6uocu1V6INXmJLBiPbF5K_PyX91TN6I83Pdb5SiGG_f9PGtj7XNCNg34JqlZwdhfiadePsDdwoG7byopWWxqBpvCW4DQRaj2AGh7fBoJRmVT1I1ItaXRPsGwOlpITewKUzA0NP4-KANWgzCA3sQk25q54rP6ms8ZUenLslbU20vtajCPUlcBI4nefZba9CO-017SG9SwKnnc_yTpmq5yxwolzDElnglO-PtqTf6tsP3q4xJVdaBNT9aKA7_NFk644zxBjKcBEa7huF-Jmv__7xsPgXAAD__1e8YhA) that killed at least three, prompted hundreds of water rescues, and left thousands without power. Over 20 school districts canceled classes on Friday. The [initial disaster declaration](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOrCAUgOGngU4C54BCQXEbu7ntloaRg5LgaoTozNtvdvrt_3zJ__WYHiGX_L38Dxv59kr7BBJMJ7FDNcWQy3vSPPqnjE5x8mrQqJW1YPnqtZkxPQEHdJggOXxah4bmPiUNg1I8-19MIioljZWDsD1JE9wcJWmpbc-0pJjbfoq2UqNXqKm894tOMe8bL35t7agM_zEYGYz3fYsWaROfUiz7xWA8Tqq1O6lQqMRgxA5cB4afPh53LiXXfmBaLlvI5aO2PzcvDz8BAAD__2UzUyM) included Cameron, Hidalgo, Starr and Willacy counties, though Abbott indicated other counties could be added as conditions warrant. Harlingen received 21.5 inches of rain on Thursday and Friday, [breaking a rainfall record](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7tuwyAUhp8GNqzDzZCBoYu3dO1oYZ_jGImYyNA4efvK2bv90n_T93MdrzHltN2-451Cey1lVKCsAC20HDGm_B4NxzABXiSnIJ3RRnqvPF-DidZGWJzq0Ti0k5qjB-c8uMUTTshTOMdAaynBenCd7wlsvMwIZMD4nhkgTK3sXVup0SvWJb_Lk_ZuLneew9raozL9xdTA1HAcRzdPdaOjnj5TwymZGmr5bav49MVUdqRdLLkUTNtNIMW2niG-B3wcKedUe8cM3O4x5c9P-xf8GdRfAAAA__-DqVuq) set in 1912. Hundreds of drivers abandoned their cars in the rising floodwaters, and local farmers and ranchers suffered significant losses of crops and livestock. One resident described the struggle to keep his belongings dry. “ _Things I stacked up, the rain, the water made it float, and it knocked it down. So everything got messed up, everything got ruined_ ,” [he said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAQQL8GOwwOKFhQXGO3115pWGdcSVAMTNbdv7_s9Ve_5OXl_dzmW4gpHo_vsJPn15pnUNBLpaXuZgwxvWfToL8rHLuGfGeNNp1z4JrND9ahXa0eHFiEcVgxjE73FEZEq-_URP-RKa27TvVO2dYNpPowLqjIKOMGYRRh5Fxa3ojpFeqa3vlJpV3y3iS_MZ9V6C8Bk4Dpuq522Uo-PlTAdNBVBUyhcFwSCZgqPamQrJzLXuWackZZuRBxleFAeZa8nyyvwFQkKDD9OPTtuZ1N8XheMaVYByuMeuwhpr8G_nfK08NvAAAA__8QQmTp).
## Troops Deployed to Big Bend
About 500 U.S. Army soldiers are being [deployed to the border](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ8GOqPjX5zCxW3S5bZbImMfh6N1MDJWSN5-RbTtdp9mpE-j-bpNN0-Z1vt__0DXXqlMAoRmIJnkU_SU35Pqo5shXniPjo9KKm6tsP3iZnHRKUiOwQiVkgQ0WpnRcD2bZDD05E4ZSMk5aAvjYA2C9pcQARUoazoFGKmVOrQFG778nvK7PLEOoTz67JbWtr2T_zpx7cT1OI4hLLWsZ9uJa6aEZ0w5_qKvjUI-6SNjq29UVp_Z5us3m-nOZlwja7WUbWcChNJW22Fbtr66uB2UM-1m7BTcH57yZ0X785anEz8BAAD__4C5ZMM) in and around Big Bend National Park as part of the Trump administration’s ongoing efforts to clamp down on illegal immigration. The troops [aren’t authorized to make arrests](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOrDAQRL_GZI0a28MjcHATsrnphqjBDVhrMLI9w_D3KzbfrKQj1SnV13N4kvNuX_7TxiZ_5jBIlA9ABaoaLDl_DbqwZkTbVQWbqtFKV20r22I1yIQ8WZoVcat1hzUR0owoq0k341w4c5ehUlWFjxabsq0ZH9RNFlmjbmuhka3LIZZ55cwfSrO_wptjOYWt8GbN-UhC_ROyF7I_z7P8TpRvKGS_85mE7H2YyAvZ3yohe1R37oTs19duI9sEYYYcQzgS8OfgKbOFHIBidG8Gt8PoFhh5txB5cWGHOUQYQ7QcIfH0ii5fsLmUbhb5CDFDout2F9HY43Teu1Q3QuOykfO_2_OfZ76N_AkAAP__TCh4kA) but will assist federal border agents with surveillance and intelligence gathering. An undisclosed number of 19-ton Stryker armored vehicles are also being deployed to the region. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said that the administration aims to “control every inch of the Southern border.” He answered that “everything is on the table” when asked about [invoking the 200-year-old Insurrection Act](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PpDAMhn9N6DwKSRigSDF3Erpmt91yZIiBaPOBkuww_PsT9Fs9lqzH1vt-fTw_0Doblk_0pMt7jk_BRQNcgqyfBq07nqoyeuSmryvSdaukqrtOdNWqe9OouTVKoWzkvenV3PVmxAb7livZjpXV5zEuZV3zpuPtrbsTb7CfDCfFVXdnipOxJaZbWanQG_PsjviidJuir5xeS9kykw8mBiaGfd9vPodzx8RAAX4yE0Og_cQ1e-tswXRASTFuGTD5mMjAi1Y7OcpgaHPxIAMlwvUPRrvASMFAwGJjQAcbpm_AfLJAnKGkH79l2ByGU5sSTt9g4h4gBrDe2yVdKhMDJng86j-ff7_-VUmbbbfO2XxvmeKLR-uuWOXXnl9a_A8AAP__ZGSDLw) to authorize the military to perform law enforcement activities on U.S. soil.
## Ancient Weapons Found in West Texas Cave
Archaeologists discovered a collection of weapons thought to be 6,000 years old inside the San Esteban Rockshelter south of Marfa, making it one of the [oldest such finds](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQxvGngS3RcWCMB4YubOna0brAJUbCcYSp4_TpK3fv_EnfT_-vy3ihXPLj_kkz-7bflhEBuxPok1Zjolzeo5HJXyENSrJXvdFGOYdOTr7reuX0LfYxqiuRHYy1g-V4TWagCFpmf5yB1kpB56A_O8vQ0RATsAHjrDDAKbelntvEjXdab-W9bFzPcZll8VNrz1XoD4FBYGjP10x3-skPPnaBgWqc8sYCwwEJDDNVgWGNy3dDOzbeIzeuJDDI6tPzlUvJq-2FgftMufwx7d_uzeNvAAAA__-czFmX) in North America. Among the artifacts are components of a [type of spear called an atlatl](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OwyAQBOCnwR3RgtcxKSiucZdrr7Q2sIlXwiYCLj9vf3L6q0cznzQ_5_lMkmS7fdPKvr2uebZgBw297s0cSdJ7xi76C8ST6dibEXs0zlnXLd7haE0w9kIGrhfCAZEiRRqCGeyI0Infx6DvjYHBwXhwR4aBTiECI6A7KgSO0nI5tIUbv6he0zs_uBxCXrvkl9buVfVfyk7KTvm3xZxL3UNlJyphIc4p36S2qqPUsFc1bUF4a_rJdM9b1bLpwmturD-CDvRgZaeu-Hh_SkpSj6NCuK0k6eO2f494ePsXAAD__7FBYhM) and a straight-flying boomerang. Next to the weapons, researchers found a tanned pronghorn hide and preserved human waste. Experts believe the cave may have [held spiritual significance](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUhJ8GOlsHOPy4oLhNutx2SwsDiY-EjWWjOHn7lVfbbvdpRpqRvq_7eA9UaH3-D0v27f2oowSpO1CdEmMKVD4j8uQnSIPg2QuLCoVz0vHZRyMm4cANFoLGAROkgApdBGOtSpKTv8ZAKSFAO7C9Mxl0GGKCjIDOMIScqNW9b3Nu-R2OR_nUV977WBde_NzadjD1j8kbk7fzPPs473W9WiZvhR75iqmkXwx7o1gumujZTXlN3ZnDVtejkyDRaG36bd747tN2Uil0GMsQnkug8nPZ_nTw8vI7AAD__ytJXJo), though the exact purpose of the deposit remains uncertain. Bryon Schroeder, director of the Center for Big Bend Studies, called the discovery a "pretty monumental finding.” “ _We get these incredible snapshots of life, vignettes of how they lived, what the environment was and how they responded to it_ ,” he said.

name: History Facts
subject: Why there are 24 hours in a day
body:
Ever wondered why there are 24 hours in a day? We have the ancient Egyptians to thank, at least in part.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68eodxyca7ys8rdu3bb9n9k0f947dfvf3r10g6qiz6w2wh8xhujfea5luzw4fymqq0af1gw1lfjhxksl0fnhrz6b3mqzzlwxy8cxfy9f86og0o25dabmnctde5xcxlj8elpgf28dz18kfzcxa&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
---
---
# [The ancient Egyptians were the first to divide the day into 24 parts.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| E ver wondered why there are 24 hours in a day? We have the [ancient Egyptians to thank](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), at least in part. The basis for our modern calendar dates back to the New Kingdom period of ancient Egypt, around 1550 BCE to 1069 BCE. During this era — about a thousand years after the construction of the Great Pyramids of Giza — the Egyptians became the first civilization to divide the day into 24 smaller parts — though with a couple of key differences to how we do it today.
---
For starters, the ancient timekeeping system tracked daytime and nighttime separately, with [each divided into 12 parts](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Also, these parts — which were measured in various ways, including sundials and water clocks — were not hours as we think of them today. Known as temporal hours or daylight hours, their length changed with the total amount of daylight at different times of year: For instance, the daytime hours would be longer in the summer than in the winter. So why 12? There are a [couple of theories](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Ancient astronomical tables suggest that nighttime was divided into 12 hours based on how the stars moved across the sky over time, as well as the cycles of the moon. It’s also possible these Egyptian timekeepers were following the [duodecimal system](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), which is based on the easily divisible number 12, and was used in many ancient cultures.
It wasn’t until the second century BCE that the idea emerged to break the day into 24 parts of equal length, a concept first introduced by the ancient Greek astronomer Hipparchus. The 24-hour day became the standard for tracking time throughout Europe in the Middle Ages, and remains so to this day.

## The term “o’clock” originated to differentiate between sundials and mechanical clocks.
Mechanical clocks were invented in Germany in the early 14th century. As they increased in popularity throughout Europe, people began to replace previous forms of timekeeping that relied on tracking the sun, such as sundials. Before long, a term originated in the English language to distinguish between these different ways of telling time. People would say it was, for example, four “of the clock” when referring to a mechanical timepiece. This eventually became [shortened to just “four o’clock](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stzixn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).” According to Merriam-Webster, the first known use of the term “o’clock” dates back to 1535.

Team,
No one believed that the Houston Cougars could be beaten in the 83' NCAA men's basketball tournament.
They had future NBA legends Clyde Drexler and Hakeem Olajuwon on their team and were riding a 26 win streak on route to the tournament championship. Yet against all odds they were beaten by a massive underdog \- the NC State Wolfpack.

body:
Make your voice heard today!
|
---

Peter,
Extremists in Congress are pushing an extreme anti-voter bill — the SAVE Act — that would make it harder, if not impossible, for millions of voters across the country to register to vote. **We need your help to stop it.**
The SAVE Act would force every voter to provide a passport or birth certificate every time they register or update their voter registration which would effectively end online and mail-in voter registration.
About half of American citizens **— _ nearly 150 million citizens _— **do not have a passport, and elderly Americans are one of the demographics least likely to have a passport. This would also disproportionately impact military voters, tribal communities, rural Americans, disaster survivors, people of color, and working-class Americans — silencing eligible voters and undermining our democracy.
This bill isn’t about election integrity. It’s about silencing voters. There’s _zero evidence of widespread voter fraud,_ and states already have secure systems in place to verify voter eligibility. **The real goal of the SAVE Act? To make it harder for eligible Americans to vote.**

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My Decision

body:
Since we started this work, we've won some tremendous victories that show anything is possible when people refuse to give up.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar25.KlmT7F&refcode=em250331-1&t=1&akid=10252%2E3935704%2Em4CSD_)_Visit to Newtown, CT._
---
Friends -
Since we started this work, we've won some tremendous victories that show anything is possible when people refuse to give up.
We've also experienced hard and often tragic setbacks that require us to summon the courage to continue fighting the next day.
I know these feelings well.
Right now, we're in the middle of those difficult times.
When this happens, it's important to think about why we set out to accomplish any goal.
And while a lot of people are familiar with my story, the truth is that it wasn't my shooting that inspired my decision to take on the challenge of making our communities safer from gun violence. Newtown was actually the moment I knew we had to do something.
I remember driving from New York to Newtown to meet with some of the parents and members of the community who lost so much that day.
We talked to the families, I walked over to an empty chair, and I said "Enough."
Our work is just as important today as it was then -- even when it looks like progress is impossible.
But I cannot do it alone. I need people who are willing to be with me not just when the issue of gun violence is in the news, but also when there seems to be so much more going on.
Because the truth is, every day families are experiencing loss because of the epidemic of gun violence. Lives are upended because of tragic loss, violent crime, threats with guns, and more.
So I am asking for your help, because I cannot do this alone:
[**Please contribute $5, $50, or whatever it is that feels right toward our work to make communities across the country safer from gun violence. It will add up when we all chip in what we can. Every little bit helps. I know that very well.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar25.KlmT7F&refcode=em250331-1&t=2&akid=10252%2E3935704%2Em4CSD_)

---
| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104848808/536679485/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250331twice_N_JZ_90DO_10_NG_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYzg2YjQ0LTM0MGUtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBGatCd4Go-xE_w7wWcr1y6j9wA6iSy0VUWaM6Gs3KM=)
---
Hi Peter,

Today is the last day of Women’s History Month. As we watch the way President Trump and his administration are conducting themselves since Inauguration Day, **we have spent much of this month reflecting on the fact that America has now failed to elect a qualified woman as president TWICE in the last decade alone.**

To add salt to the wound, the current President and his administration have brought blatant misogyny and outdated views about gender back to the mainstream. They’ve gleefully rolled back women’s access to reproductive healthcare, and continue to spread dangerous disinformation about abortion.

**At Her Bold Move, we are on a mission to elect women up and down the ballot until we have finally shattered our nation’s highest glass ceiling once and for all.**

There are qualified, brilliant women in this country who are just waiting in the wings to bring about real change. The would-be female presidents who have been waiting far too long for their turn to lead. Policymakers who, perhaps, haven’t been recorded bragging about grabbing people by the genitals... We believe these women are out there.

[**Today is your last chance to celebrate Women’s History Month with Her Bold Move. Help us continue to support _and uplift_ incredible, pro-WOMEN women candidates by donating $20.25 before midnight →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104848823/536679494/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250331twice_N_JZ_90DO_10_NG_N_L1&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYzg2YjQ0LTM0MGUtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBGatCd4Go-xE_w7wWcr1y6j9wA6iSy0VUWaM6Gs3KM=)

As research from the Wilson Center points out, “Although the presence of a woman in leadership does not automatically ensure positive change, empirical evidence underscores the broader impact of having more women in public decision-making roles. **This shift is associated with higher economic growth, improved gender equality, and greater social investment in education, healthcare, and environmental protection.”**

Two-thirds of the world’s top 50 countries have had a female leader. As you know, **the U.S. is not one of them.** Last year, Mexico elected its first female president, Claudia Sheinbaum, making her the first female president in North America. But here’s the thing, women in Mexico didn’t gain the right to vote for president until 1953. Not to mention, as recently as 9 years ago, the country didn’t have even one female governor. # ACTION ALERT: MORE GOOD BILLS IN THE SENATE AND HOUSE
|
---
**In the Senate:**
SB 883 (Sen. Paxton) and SB 2422 (Sen. Hall) are being heard in the Senate Committee on Health and Human Services on Tuesday, April 1. SB 883 would allow patients to access off-label treatments for COVID-19, and SB 2422 would prohibit the Texas Medical Board from persecuting practitioners who provide individualized patient care for COVID-19. **In the House:**
HB 3441 (Rep. Luther) and HB 3455 (Rep. Shofner) are being heard in the House Committee on the Judiciary and Civil Jurisprudence on Wednesday, April 2. HB 3441 would make vaccine manufacturers liable for injuries and deaths if they advertise their products in the state of Texas. clean_body: Last week, the Administration withdrew Elise Stefanik’s nomination to be the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations. | = Peter, it’s Democrat Blake Gendebien. Rep. Laura Gillen said I could reach out with an update on our race in NY-21. Last week, the Administration withdrew Elise Stefanik’s nomination to be the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations. It’s clear: they are scared. They’ve seen what we’ve been able to accomplish in just a few months. Thousands of grassroots donors have stepped up to help send a dairy farmer to Congress, and voters across the North Country are ready to elect a leader who will actually fight for them. Our opponents know we had a real shot at winning this race, so they’re keeping Elise Stefanik in Congress to help them cut Social Security, Medicaid, and Medicare and give more tax cuts to billionaires. But, Peter, I’m not giving up. It doesn’t matter who I’m running against or when the election might be – I’m still committed to representing the community that raised me. = | = | = | = | = | = Onward, Blake * | | = Paid for and authorized by Gillen for NY. The far left is now targeting Teslas, keying cars and vandalizing private property simply because of who made the car. We connect the dots between radical rhetoric, media incitement, and real-world destruction. Voices like Jimmy Kimmel, who mock and encourage hate, are helping fuel the fire.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

To help you learn more about Lewis, we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=7b023ff0511148f0bafa519b4a403af0&_e=L4BEooVQ33cpH4ykohVPGr1SAyEYCCWBpx3CCuQiTC4Z9i6CR6FksC0emNC9osBL294Bho3aDTzRcd9KnbbPiK7bXFFNpGOcyyjkBkV8-phF1VVFtX6-tWWQ9WQB3-kyqgX23Lpu_KYME5JUVrLv9knhv5ZgbDyv7ZHbzjU7hWwLyRkbXJiyc9UtE1P95Yt7cNx4-obln5f875BNSEULZUbHHyOE8qWE6PM--KgL24au007O9B_V1-3LiZqkHCtYc3jM6YCe4VT63eintVcmzDWnlupFf0aSJyXUqtEr1YATu6vN6wZlJzc8CcUAGV9XyXeR41ubsMHn5xdNQgnKJZqHm7qAF4eyVMuRajBygn5GX3JWH4rha1329Eh0CEaW7iSW9FehnHbZ-ti-O73WyW87F3c8pVjOCNmhDAH1mrEDYOgG50hpidSspnHXK_rH)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

The instructor, Dr. Michael Ward, is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. | Peter, Today is International Transgender Day of Visibility. There are roughly 1.6 million youth and adults who make up America’s transgender and nonbinary community. They are children, parents, siblings, friends, and spouses. They work hard to support themselves and their loved ones. And they serve our great nation in the military; in local, state, and federal government; and in other leadership positions. But fearmongering and misinformation from Donald Trump and his MAGA cronies are threatening the safety and freedoms of our transgender community. Just take a look at the chaos and devastation Trump has caused over his first two months in office: [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8308456d-957d-4e25-b6eb-fa5ee8dfddcb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Stopping servicemembers from defending our national security...blocking athletes from playing the sports they love...threatening patients’ access to healthcare...it’s almost unbelievable, Peter. We cannot let Donald Trump get away with these unjust policies. [On International Transgender Day of Visibility, will you pledge to stand with Blue Amp Action and defend the rights of transgender, nonbinary, and gender nonconforming Americans? Together, we can fight Trump’s dangerous attacks on our freedoms.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td8fce583-d715-4e5c-a43b-6b0d3525cdc8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104858516/536709750/2070612303?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250331_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZGM3YTFkOS00MDBlLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m0vwMINgNLDmgnRwvB4PvCb9szSe07SA0kR2rhPS8eQ=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104858518/536709753/2070612303?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250331_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZGM3YTFkOS00MDBlLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m0vwMINgNLDmgnRwvB4PvCb9szSe07SA0kR2rhPS8eQ=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the threat of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

AP: Federal appeals court deals a blow to Voting Rights Act, ruling that private plaintiffs can’t sue
Folks,
This ruling by the federal 8th Circuit still needs our attention, as it continues to be ignored in the media. It's one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years.

If you missed the details, the impact is pretty simple to understand: In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. According to the 8th Circuit, only the Department of Justice (DoJ) has the legal standing to sue states over voting laws.

With former Florida AG Pam Bondi -- a "big lie" spreading MAGA acolyte -- serving as Attorney General, do any of us really think that the DOJ is going to protect voting rights over the next four years?

body:

Derek, In my last few emails, I’ve kept you up to date on what Democrats are doing to fight back, organize, and win. We’re holding town halls in all 50 states, taking on Trump in the courts, and building momentum by winning these critical state and local races. And the thing about momentum? It’s contagious. Tomorrow, there are more elections in Wisconsin and Florida. The odds are stacked against us, but I don’t care. We’re not rolling over. Anyway, the rest of this email will be a little bit different, because it has to be. Our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is coming up at midnight. These deadlines might seem arbitrary, but they’re not. Our team sets quarterly goals that help determine how much money Democrats can allocate to different priorities — including how much we can invest in voter outreach for all of these different races. With the stakes so high right now, our spending decisions have a major impact. Take a look at Pennsylvania. Last week, Democrats flipped a Republican +23 seat in Lancaster County by a few hundred votes. That district hadn’t gone our way since the 1800s. And it went huge for Trump just a few months ago. Because of support from people like you, we were able to recruit volunteers to knock doors there and get out the vote. And now Republicans are terrified. So, _everything_ we do can really make a difference. When you contribute to the DNC, that’s the type of work you’re supporting. I’ve said from day one that Democrats need to get out of DC and compete everywhere, and that’s exactly what we’re doing: investing in state parties, hosting text and phone banks to support Democrats running in special elections, mobilizing thousands of volunteers, and laying the groundwork to take back Congress in 2026. **This work is only possible with grassroots donations. | | | ** **
**CALL TO ACTION!**

**SPREAD THE WORD!
$2.5B BOND ISSUE ON
OHIO'S MAY PRIMARY BALLOT!
WHAT EVERYONE NEEDS TO KNOW!
WE MUST GET THE WORD OUT!**

---
| _<**We've left last week's information on Issue 2 below just in case you missed it!** >_

**This issue is beatable!**
1) Turnout for the **May 6th PRIMARY ELECTION** is expected to be around 5% of registered Ohio voters. That's about 400,000 total votes.
2) The past 2 times a similar bond issue was on the ballot, the winning margin was 19.23%, let's round that up to 20%. That means 60% YES & 40% NO. Or, 240,000 YES votes & 160,000 NO votes. A 20% difference or 80,000 vote differential.
3) **FIRST** , if we can educate 10% of the potential YES voters & turn them to NO voters, the result would be 216,000 YES votes & 184,000 NO votes, a 24,000 vote swing. Across Ohio's 88 counties we'd need to persuade 273 YES voters to vote NO, **A VERY REASONABLE** thing to do.
4) **SECOND** , if we can activate 40,000 voters who typically don't vote in primary elections **and get them to vote** , that's a turnout increase of only 0.5%, or one-half of one percent! This is also **A VERY REASONABLE** thing for us to try to get done! It's only an additional 455 votes per county.
5) **WHEN** we do this, **WE WIN!** The final vote count would be 224,000 NO and 216,000 YES = 440,000 total votes = 5.5% turnout. Again, **A****VERY REASONABLE** objective!
**WHAT EACH OF US CAN DO TO SPREAD THE WORD AND MAKE THIS HAPPEN!**
Over the next week, **PLEASE** :
* Make 10 **social media posts** on the issue
* **Send texts** about the issue to 10 people
* **Send emails** about the issue to another (different) 10 people
* **Make calls** about the issue to 10 more (different) people
* Persuade 10 more (new) people to commit to go **to vote with you**
* Persuade 10 people not previously contacted **to make absentee (mail-in) ballot requests with your help**

_****__**Try to contact 50 DIFFERENT people.**_
If each of the 11,000+ subscribers to this email did this, we would easily defeat this **stealthy, unnecessary, costly** , $2.5B bond issue!
**LET'S MAKE IT HAPPEN!**

* * *

[**NEW**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=78e9e88fa9&e=5c740fa3e2)[**WEBPAGE FOR YOU TO BOOKMARK WITH RESOURCES TO HELP US ALL FIGHT ISSUE 2!**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=31c7ffaf2d&e=5c740fa3e2)

We [**PREVIOUSLY**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a97b0939d3&e=5c740fa3e2) made you aware there's a bond issue on the Ohio primary election ballot in May. Now we must make sure others are aware! **EARLY VOTING STARTS APRIL 8TH!**

**HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN DO TO HELP!**

1) PLEASE **forward this message** to as many people as you can, especially those who typically would not vote in a primary election!
2) PLEASE download **[THIS GRAPHIC](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=595c35f13c&e=5c740fa3e2) (same as below)** to your phone & send it to everyone you can, again, **especially those who typically would not vote in a primary election!

It's for $2.5B dollars with spending limits of $250,000,000 annually. Supposedly, it's necessary for the health and well-being of Ohio's infrastructure. | | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@freedomfrontline1776)

April 1st is a crucial day for communities across Mississippi. Our municipal elections will determine the leaders who will shape our cities, manage our resources, and represent our values. That's why it is essential for every eligible voter to show up and make their voice heard.

name: Al Canata
subject: Time is running out…
body:
The clock is ticking. Unless Congress acts, many provisions in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) are set to expire in 2025.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ziq498ab3kk3hf0a8uj5s1m7hjfh2jtuqm2bnu7o_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5gm9ob2c3h2bs)
Friend,

The clock is ticking. Unless Congress acts, many provisions in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) are set to expire in 2025.

TCJA cut individual tax rates, simplified the tax code, and reduced compliance costs.

**About 80% of Americans received a tax cut under the TCJA, with an average tax savings of over $2,100.**

TCJA was a huge win for taxpayers, and it is critical we extend the tax cuts this year.

**But should these tax cuts expire, taxpayers will see an automatic tax increase set for 2026, meaning higher taxes on hardworking families, small businesses, and job creators across the country.**

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships for the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are dedicated to holding Congress accountable and defending the rights of taxpayers.

You have a chance to make a difference.

Your support today could be the tipping point that helps us reach Congress and save TCJA before it’s too late. Can we count on you?
[Donate Now](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z50rp68g48jnuig7l2a1fp2vlk1b0vcl930jp840_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5gm9ob2c3h2bs)
TCJA delivered historic tax relief, spurred economic growth, and kept Washington’s hands out of your wallet.

And NTU is _**the**_ lead group doing education and lobbying to Capitol Hill. We’re the ones giving lawmakers and their staffs the understanding of TCJA that they need so the wallet of Americans and American companies can be protected.

Key elements of TCJA included:
* Expanded child tax credit
* Ending duplicative taxation of U.S. businesses operating overseas
* Significant reduction in the corporate income tax rate from 35 percent to 21 percent
* Full expensing, or allowing businesses to deduct the full cost of investments in the year made

The National Taxpayers Union is fighting to make these tax cuts permanent, but we need your help to pressure Congress to act NOW before it’s too late.

[Will you chip in $10, $35, or even $100 today to NTU so we can fight for you in Congress? Click here to donate now >>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z0008a6proo4gmd0okpgm78nmv0230fi98sbo698_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5gm9ob2c3h2bs)

Unless Congress acts, many provisions in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) are set to expire in 2025. TCJA cut individual tax rates, simplified the tax code, and reduced compliance costs. About 80% of Americans received a tax cut under the TCJA, with an average tax savings of over $2,100. TCJA was a huge win for taxpayers, and it is critical we extend the tax cuts this year. But should these tax cuts expire, taxpayers will see an automatic tax increase set for 2026, meaning higher taxes on hardworking families, small businesses, and job creators across the country. I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships for the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are dedicated to holding Congress accountable and defending the rights of taxpayers. You have a chance to make a difference. Your support today could be the tipping point that helps us reach Congress and save TCJA before it’s too late. Can we count on you? TCJA delivered historic tax relief, spurred economic growth, and kept Washington’s hands out of your wallet. And NTU is the lead group doing education and lobbying to Capitol Hill. We’re the ones giving lawmakers and their staffs the understanding of TCJA that they need so the wallet of Americans and American companies can be protected. Key elements of TCJA included: Expanded child tax credit Ending duplicative taxation of U.S. businesses operating overseas Significant reduction in the corporate income tax rate from 35 percent to 21 percent Full expensing, or allowing businesses to deduct the full cost of investments in the year made The National Taxpayers Union is fighting to make these tax cuts permanent, but we need your help to pressure Congress to act NOW before it’s too late. Thank you, Al Canata Vice President of Strategic Partnerships National Taxpayers Union P.S. The National Taxpayers Union is the longest-serving organization in America fighting for taxpayers. Our mission is to achieve favorable, pro-taxpayer policy outcomes using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states. Our efforts to reach Congress are working – but your help is key to make these tax cuts permanent before they expire. With your support, NTU can continue to achieve tangible results for taxpayers. “America first” is not just a slogan.

You see – the LAST FEC deadline before Tuesday’s special elections is just DAYS away.

clean_body: Please read my heartfelt note. | Friend, “America first” is not just a slogan. It’s an oath of leadership to the American people. That’s why I had to do what’s right for America and withdraw my nomination for U.N. Ambassador to remain in the House and protect our razor-thin Majority. Our country stands on the horizon of a new “Golden Age.” We cannot let the Democrats flip the House and rob us of this historic opportunity to Make America Great Again! The President entrusted me to protect the House. Now, I’m entrusting YOU. You see – the LAST FEC deadline before Tuesday’s special elections is just DAYS away. FEC reports show that in one race, the Democrat has raised $10 MILLION compared to the Republicans’ $500,000... And so, my Senior Advisor, Alex, gave me a special list of top donors – some of whom have been with us since Day One and helped me become the youngest woman elected to Congress in 2014. When I say “top” donors, these are not necessarily the biggest donors, but the loyal ones who never gave up and never lost sight of our mission to put America first. You were on the list, Friend. With the sacrifice I just made, you can be certain that I’m going ALL IN to win. And now, I need you to join me. That’s why I’m entrusting you with a 500% match ahead of the FEC CLOSE OF BOOKS before the special elections. So, are you with me? Thank you and God Bless, Rep. body:
We need to keep our state out of the hands of right-wing oligarchs.
| Hi Peter, it’s Ben Wikler, Chair of the Wisconsin Democrats.

I know how we’ve all been feeling lately – like there’s no check on what Donald Trump and Elon Musk are doing to our country. Like MAGA is all-powerful.

Peter, if you want to know where Trump and Musk’s real weakness lies, all you have to do is _follow the money._

**Elon Musk has already dropped _MILLIONS_ of dollars to bankroll Brad Schimel’s Supreme Court campaign here in Wisconsin**, because Musk and Trump know that Wisconsin’s highest court stands as a check on their lawless coup – and they know that extremist Republican Brad Schimel will be nothing but a rubber-stamp on their assault on constitutional checks and balances.

**That’s why we’re launching The People v. Musk – our official push to spread awareness about Musk’s hostile takeover of the Wisconsin Supreme Court and raise enough grassroots funding to fight back against his massive ad buys.**

[_**Will you split a $25 donation with Fight for Progress to help defeat Elon Musk, Donald Trump, and Brad Schimel, and keep Wisconsin OUT of the hands of right-wing oligarchs?**_](https://fight4progress.org/wisdems?t=jlqrA5FQpneF&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-31_2&amount=25)

Elon Musk and Donald Trump want a MAGA Supreme Court to ban abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest; to overturn elections when they don’t like the results; and to suppress voters that don’t kiss their ring.

But we’re not going to let them buy this election. With enough grassroots support from folks like you, we’ll be able to kick our organizing operation into overdrive, ensure voters learn about the stakes on April 1, reject Elon Musk’s hostile takeover of our Supreme Court, and elect a true champion for fairness and democracy, Judge Susan Crawford.

[_**So I’m asking you, Peter, will you split a $25 donation with Fight for Progress right now to win the battle between we, the People, and Elon Musk and secure our pro-freedom majority?**_](https://fight4progress.org/wisdems?t=7cSrdxxANq63&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-31_2&amount=25)

At a time when Donald Trump and Elon Musk’s chaos is harming so many in our communities, I’m standing with community leaders and our allies in Congress to forcefully push back.
Together, we’re telling the administration and congressional Republicans: **Hands off Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid!** These programs are not just services—they’re the difference between life and death.
We’re**fighting for the future of our Postal Service** , which Trump wants to privatize and sell off for parts. I’ve met and rallied with postal workers who’ve been providing an important service that people depend on, and I will keep standing up for federal workers’ rights.
We’re also **fighting to preserve the Department of Education** , which is critical to enforcing our nation’s civil rights laws and serving lower-income and working-class students, students of color, and students with disabilities. We’re also demanding protections for students who’ve been illegally kidnapped by the Department of Homeland Security.
And we’re **fighting for people’s very survival** on everything from SNAP nutrition benefits to housing, healthcare, and more.
If you’re worried about your future, your family’s future, and the future of our country―I want you to know that I see you and that I am fighting for you every single day, alongside a growing movement that’s resisting illegal and authoritarian abuses of power.

Every day, we are seeing a new attack―on Social Security, Medicaid, public education, voting rights, and much more. To make matters worse, the Trump administration is openly ignoring court rulings on everything from our due process rights to the firings of civil servants and the freezing of congressionally allocated funds to our communities. I will never stop speaking up and fighting back for you and your family. And I need you by my side now more than ever. Tonight at midnight is a critical fundraising deadline. After today, we’ll report to the Federal Election Commission how much we’ve raised and spent, and how much cash-on-hand we have for the fight ahead. Our opponents will look for weakness. We need to show the strength of our movement for change. | At a time when Donald Trump and Elon Musk’s chaos is harming so many in our communities, I’m standing with community leaders and our allies in Congress to forcefully push back. Together, we’re telling the administration and congressional Republicans: Hands off Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid! These programs are not just services—they’re the difference between life and death. We’refighting for the future of our Postal Service , which Trump wants to privatize and sell off for parts. I’ve met and rallied with postal workers who’ve been providing an important service that people depend on, and I will keep standing up for federal workers’ rights. We’re also fighting to preserve the Department of Education , which is critical to enforcing our nation’s civil rights laws and serving lower-income and working-class students, students of color, and students with disabilities. We’re also demanding protections for students who’ve been illegally kidnapped by the Department of Homeland Security. And we’re fighting for people’s very survival on everything from SNAP nutrition benefits to housing, healthcare, and more. If you’re worried about your future, your family’s future, and the future of our country―I want you to know that I see you and that I am fighting for you every single day, alongside a growing movement that’s resisting illegal and authoritarian abuses of power. body:

Everyone else gets stripped from their community’s town hall.

Dear Peter, By now I’m sure you’ve heard of the “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” (SAVE) Act: one of the most restrictive voter ID requirements we've ever seen. If the SAVE Act passes, someone you know could lose the right to vote. It would create unnecessary barriers to voting, by requiring voters to provide strict proof of citizenship, such as a passport or birth certificate, to register or update their voter registration. This bill is based on unfounded claims of voter fraud. name: Jon Husted
subject: A little about me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
I didn’t come from the usual background you might imagine.

Friend,

I didn't come from the usual background you might imagine.

The first months of my life were spent in a foster home, unsure of where I was headed or what the future held.

But everything changed when I was adopted by two amazing parents. They gave me the love, guidance, and support that allowed me to build a life I could never have imagined.

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z79egt9kdcm4ftvu4bf1bi1ts7fb04ruqni8rgm0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)

__I grew up in a small town in northwest Ohio where the values of faith, family, freedom, personal responsibility, and hard work were at the heart of everything.__

It was a community where neighbors cared for each other, and where I learned that no matter where you come from, with grit and determination, you can create your own future.

**[I have gone from being a Division III college football player (go Flyers!) to working in public service, eventually being appointed by Governor DeWine to fill JD Vance's open Senate seat.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zj3q767jcvb4e968f64h5ane74jagdrs75abdjpg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)**

**[Now, I'm facing an uphill battle with my re-election campaign for 2026 already underway, so I am coming directly to you for your support.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zr5jh13flqqt7dbi9k7j5agcr1d6v80em0q9vul0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)**

******************************************************[CHIP IN NOW->](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z85ff19k0t8pi3g0f9pef4qtk63fal7sr8j3jd88_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)******************************************************

This race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive and hard-fought Senate contests Ohio has ever seen, friend.

**[To make matters worse, the radical Left has already labeled me as one of their TOP TARGETS for taking back control of the Senate.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztd0b5k701g0g885j4sr7h13hmk2ba4qoqfvjq78_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)**

**[I can't afford to fall behind this early in the race, so will you please chip in whatever you can today to help defend my Senate seat?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvufnrqtteo108pl3f95ndiahabfrsqbkksolnao_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)**

******************************************************[CHIP IN NOW->](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkske933df0bnt6n9k51m9bkftkf6f9pt10q17bo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c5imco36cph2bs)******************************************************

Thank you,

Senator Jon Husted

body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Did anyone miss these end-of-quarter emails? I doubt it. But, I do think it’s important to remember that we are on a path to holding the Trump administration and House Republicans accountable. It’s important to remember that elections are not that far away. And it’s important to remember what we can do when we work together.
With everything going on, we have to focus on what we can accomplish now — in the Congress, in the courts, and in the community — and also focus on what we can do in the long term. And there is no doubt that there is one thing we must do: win elections.
We can reject the chaos and the cruelty that have marked these first few months of this administration. And we can take back the House. House Republicans aren’t just failing to fight back against the destruction and chaos in Washington, they are cheering it on. While winning back the House won’t fix everything, it will matter. It will mean that Congress can assert its authority that the Republicans who are now in charge have handed over to Elon Musk and his fellow MAGA billionaires. It will mean that the House can exercise oversight of the Trump administration.
So, why does tonight’s FEC fundraising deadline matter? With Trump in the White House and Republicans in charge of the House and Senate, Democrats are out of power. But we are not out of options. name: Juanita, United We Dream Action
subject: The cost of Trump’s chaos keeps running up
body:
We’re ready to protect our communities and fight for the future we want. | | | Peter, **** **Trump’s chaos is costing us jobs —**** _hundreds and thousands of them_****.** This isn’t on accident. Trump _CHOSE_ to lay off federal employees, gut federal agencies, and wipe out paychecks amid the unstable economy _HIS_ administration created. The reach of these cuts extends far beyond Washington, too. A healthcare worker with the Veteran Affairs division in Michigan lost her job after 28 years, just four years away from retirement. A dad in Iowa lost his dream job as an educator with our National Parks, leaving him scrambling to make ends meet. While hardworking educators and healthcare workers are laid off, billionaires like Elon Musk are reaping the rewards. And as he rakes in taxpayer dollars, the prices of basic necessities like eggs, milk, and gasoline are skyrocketing. **These aren’t broken campaign promises.** We can’t forget that Trump is doing exactly what he said he would do, as laid out in Project 2025 — gut public services while increasing immigration enforcement and funneling more taxpayer dollars into ICE to terrorize our communities. And we can’t ignore that U.S. immigration enforcement officials arrested more immigrants last month than _any month in the last seven years._ This chain reaction is resulting in widespread unemployment, affecting families and communities nationwide.
**[The cost of Trump’s chaos keeps running up. Whatever comes next, United We Dream Action's people-powered movement is ready to protect our communities and fight for the future we want. clean_body: We’re ready to protect our communities and fight for the future we want. | | | Peter, ** Trump’s chaos is costing us jobs —** hundreds and thousands of them. This isn’t on accident. Trump CHOSE to lay off federal employees, gut federal agencies, and wipe out paychecks amid the unstable economy HIS administration created. The reach of these cuts extends far beyond Washington, too. A healthcare worker with the Veteran Affairs division in Michigan lost her job after 28 years, just four years away from retirement. A dad in Iowa lost his dream job as an educator with our National Parks, leaving him scrambling to make ends meet. While hardworking educators and healthcare workers are laid off, billionaires like Elon Musk are reaping the rewards. And as he rakes in taxpayer dollars, the prices of basic necessities like eggs, milk, and gasoline are skyrocketing. These aren’t broken campaign promises. We can’t forget that Trump is doing exactly what he said he would do, as laid out in Project 2025 — gut public services while increasing immigration enforcement and funneling more taxpayer dollars into ICE to terrorize our communities. And we can’t ignore that U.S. immigration enforcement officials arrested more immigrants last month than any month in the last seven years. This chain reaction is resulting in widespread unemployment, affecting families and communities nationwide. Only supporters like you can make that happen.
---
[_ _**I’m with you!**_ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67eacdd25cdc7e780e25ed7b&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fmar-2025-eoq-3&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67ea984ff5dec020c558ddf3&l=en-US&s=EFOWC2VF6yZqQfxpw3i5MY5-Yi4%3D)

### Governor Healey's Interview: Rhetoric vs. Reality
---
---
| Boston, MA- Governor Maura Healey's recent appearance on WCVB's On the Record was a masterclass in political spin. Time and again, the Governor's statements contradicted the actions and policies of her administration.
When asked about cooperation with ICE and the recent arrests by federal agents, Healey claimed, "I have no problem with taking people off the streets who are committing violent crimes, who are engaged in drug trafficking," and insisted Massachusetts is not a sanctuary state.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale was quick to call out the blatant contradiction:
"Governor Healey's rhetoric does not align with reality. She claims to support working with ICE, yet refuses to back efforts to reverse the 2017 Lunn Decision, which prevents courts and municipalities from honoring ICE detainers. Time and again, illegal immigrants arrested for heinous crimes in Massachusetts have been released due to the state's sanctuary policies--despite active ICE detainers. For the Governor to suggest she has 'no problem' working with ICE to remove dangerous criminals is simply false, and it's even more egregious for her to claim Massachusetts is not a sanctuary state. The policies she defends are precisely what make it one."
When pressed about public safety, Healey asserted, "In Massachusetts, the facts are we're among the safest states in the country." Carnevale pushed back:
"It is outrageous for the Governor to make this claim when, under her leadership, over 200 illegal immigrants charged or convicted of horrific crimes have been allowed to remain in our communities--interacting with our children and families. How can she call Massachusetts 'safe' when thousands of individuals live here with identities and criminal histories entirely unknown? Her words don't match the facts."
The Governor's mischaracterization of the Lunn Decision further exposed her misleading narrative:
"The Lunn Decision does the exact opposite of what the Governor claims. It blocks our courts and law enforcement from honoring ICE detainers. Because of this ruling, illegal immigrants arrested for serious crimes in Massachusetts are routinely released back into our communities. It is one of the biggest reasons dangerous criminals remain on our streets."
On illegal immigration, Healey went even further, arguing that her approach is "working." Carnevale responded:
"How can Governor Healey possibly believe her extreme progressive policies on public safety and illegal immigration are 'working'? Just last week, the federal government had to intervene and remove over 200 criminal illegal immigrants from Massachusetts. Why did it take ICE to step in and protect our communities? Because Governor Healey and her administration refuse to enforce the law. Her policies endanger Massachusetts residents--plain and simple."

### Housing: Another Failed Promise

Governor Healey touted her housing policy as a major achievement, claiming her administration has created 4,000 new housing units while acknowledging the state needs 220,000. Carnevale didn't hold back:
"The Governor boasts about 4,000 new units while admitting the state needs 220,000. That's a dismal record for her so-called 'top priority.' Worse, her radical green energy mandates have made development in Massachusetts even more expensive and nearly impossible to justify financially. If this is her crowning achievement, it speaks volumes about how disastrous her tenure has been."

### Migrant Crisis: An Avoidable Disaster

Attempting to deflect blame, Healey claimed she "inherited" the migrant crisis and touted a reduction in shelter numbers. Carnevale set the record straight:
"We know that's simply not true. Under Governor Baker, there was no migrant crisis. FOIA documents obtained by the MassGOP reveal a surge in crimes within migrant shelters under Healey's watch. She and the Democratic supermajority in the legislature are directly responsible for this disaster. Any reduction in numbers isn't due to her leadership--it's because the federal government has been forced to intervene."
The Governor also claimed taxpayer spending on the crisis is decreasing, but Carnevale exposed the truth:
"Healey's claim that the state is spending less is just political cover. Strong reporting has shown that migrants aren't leaving the system--they're simply being moved from hotels into taxpayer-subsidized apartments across the state. Massachusetts taxpayers are on the hook for over a billion dollars a year due to her refusal to act. Instead of fixing the problem, she's hiding the spending."

### Energy Policy: Healey's Hypocrisy

On rising utility bills, Healey admitted, "We need more energy into the region." Carnevale found this statement laughable:
"The Governor's hypocrisy couldn't be clearer. As Attorney General, she actively blocked two natural gas pipelines that would have provided relief to Massachusetts families. Now, she has the audacity to claim we need more energy while refusing to take responsibility for the crisis she created. If she hadn't blocked those pipelines, we wouldn't be in this situation."

### Healey's Legacy: A State in Crisis

Carnevale concluded with a stark warning for Massachusetts voters:
"Governor Healey tells one story, but the facts tell another. She claims she's cutting taxes while pushing new ones on cars, candy, and prescription drugs. She says she supports ICE while refusing to reverse policies that shield criminal illegal immigrants. She claims she's helping developers while championing regulations that make housing unaffordable. She's a savvy politician--but a terrible executive. That's a dangerous combination for Massachusetts."
"Fortunately, voters will have a clear choice in the coming months. The MassGOP is proud to support strong Republican candidates who will put the people of Massachusetts first and build a state that works for everyone."

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8420%2E5257348%2ErGfjq7 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Over the weekend, Elon Musk spread more lies about me at a major rally,
Derek.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12025_abs_em.9NB2Ka&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250331_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8420%2E5257348%2ErGfjq7 ]Before I dive into the latest smears against me, I have to ask: Can you
chip in to help me respond? The lies against me are ramping up, and I have
an important campaign fundraising deadline at midnight.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12025_abs_em.9NB2Ka&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250331_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8420%2E5257348%2ErGfjq7 ]DONATE

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12025_abs_em.9NB2Ka&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250331_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=8420%2E5257348%2ErGfjq7 ]Elon Musk wearing a cheesehead

Q: Has the DOGE team found any evidence that any of the radical left
Democrats — like Maxine Waters, Adam Schiff, Chuck Schumer — have received
money directly from USAID?

Elon: There is a massive amount of corruption... I’m highly confident that a
bunch of that money comes back to the United States and lands in the
pockets of the people you just mentioned. It does not go directly, but
there’s a lot of strangely wealthy members of Congress where I’m trying to
connect the dots of how they get rich.

Let me connect the dots for you, Elon.

No, I do not personally benefit from USAID money. That’s a lie and you
know it.

But the people who do benefit — the millions of people worldwide who are
struggling with famine, disease, natural disasters, and war — are now
facing catastrophic blows to their lives and communities. Just last week,
there was a devastating earthquake in Myanmar — and the United States has
offered no help to the area. We have abandoned the field of humanitarian
aid to other countries that use it for leverage, like China. And the
result will be deadly. From HIV treatment to tuberculosis treatments,
people are going to die because of Elon’s disdain for the poor.

And the administration has abandoned our legacy of helping others in order
to fund tax cuts for billionaires just like Elon.

It’s a disgrace.

For decades, USAID has provided vital humanitarian aid that saves lives
and creates longstanding relationships with our allies.

By withdrawing all aid, we’re abandoning millions of people in desperate
need of support. And we’re doing it in the cruelest fashion — refusing to
help those in need to instead give tax cuts to the rich.

I’m fighting back. It goes against our country’s values to turn our backs
on those suffering. And it is why Elon Musk is targeting me.

So while Elon attacks me and advocates for more massive cuts in foreign
aid, I’m working to restore that aid and bring back decency to our
country’s leaders. I’ve joined Senate Democrats in speaking out,
protesting, and putting holds on Senate confirmations until the Trump
administration backs down.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12025_abs_em.9NB2Ka&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20250331_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=8420%2E5257348%2ErGfjq7 ]As I stand up to Elon Musk — the richest man in the world — to advocate
for those in need, I am asking for your support. Elon loves to attack me,

Greetings from Gay Valmont, your Democratic pick for Florida’s first congressional district. We don’t have much time left. A mere 24 hours separates the results of this election from the time of this email.
In those 24 hours I once again ask for your help because without you, this journey would not have been possible. What do you say, partner?

All I need is a $20 donation today to make sure that our efforts stay strong pamphlets at meetings and countless doors knocked can be achieved with your help in this most crucial hour. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

RUSH $25 or more today to boost turnout in special elections, inform potential voters, defend our fundamental right to vote, and so much more >> [https://secure.everyaction.com/Z31SNww9Q0CZWIdx46cuSQ2]

CFPM: Florida holds special primary election to fill vacancies in U.S. House
You can tell that we're making progress in Florida, Team, because the MAGA crew just pulled back Congresswoman Elise Stefanik's nomination to be the U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. -- worried that it might cost them the House.
As a reminder: Florida is holding a special election on Tuesday to fill vacancies in the U.S. House of Representatives, following cabinet nominations by President Donald Trump. And they're worried about opponents of voting rights losing elections in districts Trump won by 30 points last fall.
What else makes these special elections important? Opponents of voting rights hold a 3 seat majority -- 218 to 215 -- in the House. One media report after another tells the tale -- Speaker Mike Johnson is having a hard time wrangling them all to vote for his priorities, and any dent made in that majority will make it harder for them to pass bills that harm voting rights this year or next.
It all starts with the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act which would nationalize voter suppression and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which would add onerous voter ID requirements, potentially disenfranchising millions of married women who changed their last names. Those bills are just the tip of the suppressive iceberg, with many in Congress looking to follow the election lies to policies that disenfranchise voters and make Trump happy.
We can stop all that with huge voter turnout in these Florida specials. But we need your help to make sure every voter in Florida is aware of these special elections, when early voting starts, how to request a new mail-in ballot, and so much more.

Peter,

I don’t do this often. My husband Dan Crenshaw – the Texas Congressman and former Navy SEAL - is usually the one sending these emails.

But I wanted to jump in and help with the End-of-Quarter deadline just hours away and Dan’s funds critically low after emptying his coffers to defend Texas and the Republican House majority in 2024.

So I reached out to his campaign team and asked if I could send a message to all of Dan’s top supporters, like you Peter, in hopes that we could surprise Dan and get his fundraising back on track before he has to report his numbers to the FEC.

[So with just hours left before the End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline, please make an URGENT contribution to Dan’s campaign to help him replenish his warchest.](https://secure.winred.com/crenshawforcongress/major-fec-deadline/?utm_campaign=20250331&utm_medium=email&utm_source=TLC_A)
