This isn’t about politics as usual, it’s about saving the House of Representatives from descending into chaos. Your donation today isn’t just a contribution, it could be the difference between victory and a defeat that could haunt us for years if we fail.

[CLOSE THE GAP](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e13055441/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9yYW5keS1maW5lLWZvci1jb25ncmVzcy9yZl9kb25fb21fZXJfcmYtbW9lX3JzXzIwMjUwMzMx/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNTAzMzE/LbmNsWWx2dTNLZQ/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPWZ0ZDEmX25saWQ9UFNWSlBCbkI2VCZfbmhpZHM9bmNXR1F1N0VBQ3oza0tscw/gZ-sgNw/sdt69808727)
Please stand with me to _**protect Congress**_ , to _**protect our country**_ , to **_protect everything that’s been built since we put President Trump back in the White House_.**

**__[We’ve come too far to lose now, let’s fight like hell and take this race across the finish line](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e13055441/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9yYW5keS1maW5lLWZvci1jb25ncmVzcy9yZl9kb25fb21fZXJfcmYtbW9lX3JzXzIwMjUwMzMx/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNTAzMzE/LbmNsWWx2dTNLZQ/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPWZ0ZDEmX25saWQ9U0pnZGJiZUJoRCZfbmhpZHM9bmNXR1F1N0VBQ3oza0tscw/gZ-sgNw/sdp9b8c30aa)_._**

As we reach the last day of March, my campaign is up against our first big fundraising deadline and I'm reaching out today to ask for your help.

Campaigns are required to file a report of the total amount our campaign has raised as of tonight, March 31, 2025.

For better or worse, this disclosure will be used to measure the strength of our campaign. As the only Republican candidate for Lieutenant Governor that's qualified for the ballot so far, press and pundits will be looking to see if we have what it takes to defeat the Democrats this year.

We know we've got what it takes, but it's critical that we show that strength on this first public filing.

I'm asking for your help tonight to make that happen. Peter,
On Sunday night, Elon Musk stood on a stage in Green Bay in a cheesehead hat and handed out $1 million checks to two voters just days before an election he's trying to buy.
It's insulting to be frank.
Not just because Musk has already spent more than $20 million to elect far-right Supreme Court candidate Brad Schimel or because he's parroting Trump's talking points about "saving civilization."
It's insulting because it shows exactly what Musk really thinks of Wisconsin voters: That they're gullible. That they're for sale. That he doesn't have to make a real case because he can just throw money at a crowd and expect them to fall in line.
At GOTV PAC, we're betting on something better.
We're not waving around oversized checks. We're funding real conversations with real people through one of the most cost-effective voter turnout programs in the country.
Every voter we reach between now and tomorrow is a rejection of Musk's politics of arrogance and control. Hi, it’s Secretary of State Tobias Read.
Tonight at midnight is my first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since I took office as Oregon’s Secretary of State.
In the months since taking office, I’ve been fighting to protect voters’ rights, increase government transparency at a time when that feels shockingly rare, and advocate for regular folks here in Oregon.

subject: It’s up to us. Truly.

body:
https://www.lateefahsimon.com [https://www.lateefahsimon.com]
Friend,
Earlier this month, I was grateful to have the opportunity to deliver the Working Families Party’s response to President Trump’s address to Congress. I outlined a vision for the United States grounded in community, compassion, and progress—not bigotry and selfishness.
Since then, Trump and his cronies have continued making a mess of everything, and not just in their group chats...
But the future I’m fighting for—the one I described in my speech—is still within reach. If you, like so many of us, don’t like what’s happening, don’t give up. We have the power to change it .
We can elect everyday folks to lead our school boards and state legislatures. We can send the smartest and most competent members of our communities to represent us and stand up for our safety.
We can change this whole thing.
But that starts with rejecting every single part of Trump’s extremist agenda.
Imagine a future where:
* Healthcare is a human right—not a privilege.
* Every public school is a great school.
* Reproductive freedom and abortion rights are protected.
* Affordable housing is a reality, and home ownership is within reach.
* Workers can unionize without fear and get the fair wages they deserve.
* Our broken immigration system is reformed, and there’s a real path to citizenship.
You have the power to change our reality. We all do. But it takes collective power.
This year is our chance to build the momentum we need to turn the tide. And it all starts right here. With you.
This is my first end-of-quarter deadline [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wfpsotu-las-address?refcode=x_250331_power_eoq1_act] as a member of Congress. Hitting our goal will mean I can keep fighting for a better future for all of us—not just the wealthiest few—in Congress. I’m standing firmly against Trump’s dangerous agenda. Our children deserve better.
Would you consider donating to my first end-of-quarter deadline TONIGHT at MIDNIGHT so my team and I can work on rejecting Trump’s extremist agenda and building the future we deserve? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wfpsotu-las-address?refcode=x_250331_power_eoq1_act]
